properties.locationName: V200 DRain inside Peenya Industrial Area

properties.findings: Eleven pharmaceutical and personal care products (PPCPs) (sulfamethoxazole, chloramphenicol, ethyl paraben, diclofenac, propylparaben, ibuprofen, BP-1, oxybenzone, bisphenol A, triclosan, triclocarban) were investigated for their occurrence, seasonal variation, and toxicological effects on the biota. The PPCPs belong to different classes like non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, antibiotics, antibacterials, UV-filters, plasticizer, and preservatives. Ibuprofen was present in high concentrations (1834 ng/L) followed by triclosan (1761 ng/L) and diclofenac (1130 ng/L) in the river.

properties.contributor: Visvesvaraya Technological University and BMS college of Engineering
properties.findings: The present study in the Peenya Industrial Area in Bengaluru, India, carried out to assess the level of heavy metal contamination in the industrial area's soil and groundwater. The study also discusses the potential health risks that inhabitants would suffer from consuming contaminated groundwater. In the current study, the Heavy Metal Pollution Index (HPI), Hazard Index (HQ [ing]) and Cancer Risk factor (CR) were calculated to assess the potential health risk. The HPI value inside the Peenya industrial area exceeded the critical pollution index value of 100. The hazard index (HQ [ing]) via oral ingestion was found to be > 1.00 in Cr, Hg & As during both seasons, indicating maximum health impacts in the inhabitants of the study area. Cancer index values were >10-4 in Cr, Ni, Cd, and Pb in the research area, posing cancer risk in people of all ages, from children to adults.
properties.period: Before and after the monsoon season of 2021.

properties.locationName: Site A: Upstream of TG Halli Reservoir, Arkavathi
properties.findings: Banned pesticides detected (lindane isomers, heptachlor, DDT, endosulfan); highest sediment nitrogen of the study (~3,576 mg/L TN); TDS ~1,400 mg/L. Baseline site upstream of the reservoir planned to augment Bengaluru's supply.

properties.locationName: Site B: Downstream of TG Halli Reservoir, Arkavathi
properties.findings: Multiple parameters above national and international standards after the Kumudavathi confluence and TG Halli outflow; phosphorus at eutrophic levels.

properties.locationName: Site C: Upstream of Muduwadi Bridge, Arkavathi
properties.findings: Control site before the Vrishabhavathi confluence, downstream of Ramanagara's silk industries; oil & grease detected; limited government monitoring here.
Captures the combined impact of the Vrishabhavathi inflow and Kanakapura town flows; BOD 6.7 mg/L with contamination above guideline values.

properties.locationName: Site E: Sai Spoorthi Hydropower Anecut, Arkavathi
properties.findings: Remote downstream site near Sangama: BOD lowest of the study (2.3 mg/L) yet pollutants above international guidelines persist this far down.
Worst site of the study: BOD ~107 mg/L, DO 0.8 mg/L, COD 237 mg/L, oil & grease ~44 mg/L; sediment cadmium ~7.4 mg/kg. Hotspot for illegal tanker dumping, downstream of major industrial zones.

properties.locationName: Site G: Downstream of Rising Sun Anecut, Vrishabhavathi
properties.findings: Cumulative pollution downstream of Byramangala and Harohalli Industrial Area, after the Suvarnamukhi confluence.
